text: Alpecin is a brand of Dr. Wolff Group, the Bielefeld-based consumer company (Dr. Kurt Wolff cosmetics and Dr. August Wolff medical divisions). The group names Alpecin among its strong brands and describes itself as a Bielefeld-based family business in its fourth generation.
short: Alpecin is a brand of Dr. Wolff Group, a Bielefeld family business.

source.name: Dr. Wolff Group: home page
source.quote: Everyone is sure to know one of our strong brands from Bielefeld: Alpecin, Alcina, Plantur, Karex, Linola, Bioniq® and Vagisan.
source.note: Same page: 'We are a Bielefeld-based family business in its fourth generation' and 'we are two different companies: Dr. Kurt Wolff (cosmetics division) and Dr. August Wolff (medical division)'.
